scope: LibreCAD_3 ordinary open-clamped spline Bezier conversion
head: c000f4a94349b5ddfe904ef29545950059143f40

findings.baseline: Source knot vector was ignored; for a quadratic control polygon the seam was x=2 instead of x=1.5. The new test failed on the base.
findings.change: Use finite, ordered, open-clamped ordinary spline source knots with separated distinct values, when TinySpline accepts and converts them; use the previous default clamped curve otherwise.
findings.degree_one: Degree-one spline conversion previously yielded no Bezier segments. Represent each linear piece as an exactly equivalent quadratic Bezier and handle the degenerate quadratic line-intersection equation. A shared normalized linear-conic solver handles the previously zero-leading-term circle/arc and translated/rotated ellipse/elliptical-arc cases.

validation.build: lckernel built with pinned bundled libdxfrw
validation.geometry: 17/17 targeted Bezier and spline tests passed, including degree-one crossing and parallel lines, circles, tangency, no intersection, small radius, arcs, translated/rotated ellipses and forward/reversed elliptical arcs.
validation.persistence: 2/2 existing fit-only and spline reopen/resave tests passed
validation.independent_evaluator: ezdxf 1.4.5 BSpline returned quadratic seam (1.5,2,3) and cubic seam (1.96,0.9200000000000002,2)
validation.negative_control: Quadratic seam test failed against unmodified master; degree-one segment test failed with the preceding PR head; the line-crossing control failed before the solver change. Degree-one circle and ellipse controls failed before the shared conic solver.

limits: Native GUI, hosted CI and other platforms remain pending.
Rational, periodic, non-clamped, near-coincident and otherwise unsupported knots retain old fallback and remain unqualified.
Conic evidence covers the selected planar cases; other spline degrees, degenerate conics, 3D conic intersections and native GUI behavior remain unqualified.
This does not qualify DWG parsing or close P8-D.
